tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels and lists; also the top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, idea rows, project rows, the stage rail card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Row hover, secondary buttons, the active segmented option, neutral badge fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, the audio player, expanded evidence wells.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Behind video and storyboard thumbnails only, near-black in both themes so footage reads true.

tokens.name: on-well
tokens.usage: Captions, play glyphs and durations drawn on `well`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, panel borders, table rules. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes), pending stage nodes and outlines; ≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: one-liners, descriptions, field labels, stage labels in the rail. Holds 4.5:1 on every surface and on all `*-tint` fills.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, providers, table headers, placeholders. 4.5:1 on `surface` and `bg`; don't put it on tints.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary button fill, active nav underline, the attention count. Fill only; text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal` / `signal-hover` (8:1+).

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Stage or project in progress (machine working); the live polling dot. Text/icon on `surface` and `running-tint`.

tokens.name: running-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind running badges.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Gate paused for you: badge text, gate banner border and kicker. Text/icon on `surface` and `waiting-tint`.

tokens.name: waiting-tint
tokens.usage: Gate banner fill, the waiting row in the stage rail, waiting badges.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Stage done, project published, claim sourced. A blue-leaning teal so it never relies on red/green alone; always paired with a check glyph.

tokens.name: done-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind done badges and success notices.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Stage or project failed, destructive reject, unsourced claim. Always paired with an × or alert glyph.

tokens.name: failed-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind failed badges, stage error lines, the danger button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.sample: A day on Venus is longer than its year
styles.usage: Page titles and the project header title. One per screen.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Gate banner title, the script hook.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Venus takes 243 Earth days to turn once on its axis.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: The run stops here. Brief, script and assets are kept.
styles.usage: Hints, badge text, row secondary lines.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers: section labels, table headers, the gate kicker.

styles.name: t-mono
styles.usage: Durations, providers, timestamps, ids, versions, scores. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: t-mono-sm
styles.usage: Tags (domain, origin, visual kind), stage keys, counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and tags; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and panel horizontal padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Column gap in the project detail grid; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section breaks on a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, thumbnails, strip segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices, the audio player.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, lists, gate banner, the video frame.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Panels and rows never cast shadows; they use `line`.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside rows (idea actions, panel actions).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit height on coarse pointers; the gate's primary button on narrow screens.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height; sticky offsets use it.

tokens.name: preview-w
tokens.usage: Width of the 9:16 render preview on wide layouts (240 × 427).
